# Dreamlore

> Dreamlore is a dream journal app by Bitfuzed for Android. It transcribes a spoken dream on the device, returns an interpretation grounded in public-domain dream literature with verbatim, verified quotes, can generate a picture of the dream, and stores the journal only on the phone. Free tier; Dreamlore Plus is a monthly or yearly subscription, the yearly plan with a 3-day free trial.

## What it does
- Voice or typed dream capture; speech is transcribed on-device, audio never uploaded.
- Interpretation grounded in Freud's *The Interpretation of Dreams*, *Dream Psychology*, and Miller's *Ten Thousand Dreams Interpreted*. Every quote is checked word-for-word against the source before display.
- Dream pictures (Plus): a painting generated from the dream text, saved with the entry.
- Local-only journal and recurring-symbol insights. No ads, no ad ID.

## What it is not
Dreamlore is for reflection and journaling. It is not medical, psychological, or predictive advice, and is not a substitute for professional care. It detects expressed self-harm intent and shows crisis resources instead of an interpretation.

## Pricing
Free: limited readings per day and month. Dreamlore Plus: monthly or yearly via Google Play; yearly starts with a 3-day free trial. Prices are shown in the store in local currency.
